mapper.insert: INSERT INTO timeout_task (task_type, callback_group, biz_id, action_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{taskType}, #{callbackGroup}, #{bizId}, #{actionTime}, #{nextFireTime}, #{status}, #{retryCount}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, task_type, callback_group, biz_id, action_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at FROM timeout_task WHERE status IN ('WAITING', 'RETRYING') AND next_fire_time <= #{dueBefore} ORDER BY next_fire_time LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT id, task_type, callback_group, biz_id, action_time, next_fire_time, status, retry_count, created_at, updated_at FROM timeout_task WHERE status = 'FAILED' ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM timeout_task WHERE status = 'FAILED'
